claim_recommendations.enforcement_ceiling: Audit-only for direct unguarded execution or dispatch with demonstrated untrusted control.
claim_recommendations.rationale: The packet mixes restricted evaluators, trusted extension hooks, CLI execution, guarded HTTP dispatch, and one unknown configured API path; one rule cannot distinguish them.

claim_recommendations.enforcement_ceiling: Audit-only for dynamically sourced template strings pending provenance and permission review.

claim_recommendations.enforcement_ceiling: Advisory only unless command construction includes demonstrably untrusted data.
